regions.cleaned_text: Mrs. Marjorie Warren - 35 - and Family - Husband - Episcopelian - careless in regard to family for some time. - asks for divorce from lutherine wife. She enrolls the Family To-nite. 18th - No improvement so far in outlook; Mrs. advised to turn to Mary our Bl. Mother.

regions.cleaned_text: Robert Hamilton - 44 - Enrolled last Wednesday expecting brain, tumor operation on Friday. Dr's who had X-rayed his head were astounded at finding no tumor atal.
